title: focuser_primaluce switched the ARCO off at every rotator disconnect, so the next connect lost the ARCO calibration
summary: The rotator disconnect sent {"set":{"ARCO":0}} and the connect {"set":{"ARCO":1}}. On a SESTO SENSO 3 (firmware 1.0.9) switching the ARCO port on again sets CALRESTART.MOT2, so the ARCO needed calibration after almost every connect. INDI only enables the ARCO.

resolution.evidence: 20261023193406-58c7-primaluce-arco-keep-enabled/verification.md: the connect switches the ARCO on only when the full state reports it off and the disconnect leaves it on; rotator_lifecycle and sestosenso3_arco_stays_calibrated pass and fail with the old disconnect; recorded run 67/67; hardware: three disconnect/reconnect cycles kept CALRESTART.MOT2 at 0 with no ARCO switch-off.
